highlights.title: One card per handoff
highlights.text: When a teammate waits on another before starting, you now see its handoff card once, with a short line when the work begins, instead of the same card twice.

highlights.title: See when a teammate switched accounts
highlights.text: When a teammate runs out of usage and carries on with another account, its result in the team chat says so: a small "on Work Claude", with the reason when you point at it.

fixes: A summary you stopped stays stopped after kwant restarts: the lead no longer starts reviewing on its own.
During a handoff the Stop button just says Stop, and a team discussion shows its turn as "turn 2, up to 4".
